name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: An accessible month grid with single or range selection, min/max and disabled days, event dots and a built-in month/year picker.
improvements: Full WAI-ARIA date grid: arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown (with Shift for years), Home/End, roving tabindex and month changes announced to screen readers.
Month and year are picked from an in-calendar grid instead of a nested select, so the year list no longer jumps off-screen (#6552, #6388).
The previous-month button is correctly disabled at minDate (#6541), and keyboard focus is clamped to min/max.
Range selection with a hover preview, plus single-date mode.
Locale-aware names, digits, first day of the week (Intl week info) and right-to-left layout with no date library.
